Ellen Park: Heads up 10x Capital asked for a single RFI cell that explains POC operational runbook: who owns scale decisions, how fallback is triggered, billing impact, and a procurement-safe one-liner. Can we draft?

Diego Morales: Draft row name: 'POC ops & overflow handling'. Keep columns: Owner, Trigger, Behavior, Latency impact (p99), Billing note, Addendum required.

Ava Singh: Owner = Customer SRE + Redwood on-call. Trigger = auto (utilization/p99) or manual (console/API). Behavior = if fallback enabled, route overflow to hosted-variant; if disabled, reject new requests.

Ellen Park: They want explicit latency guidance. Any conservative numbers for 20 qps chat (avg 220 tokens)?

Diego Morales: Conservative: Dedicated p99 ~200-260ms, fallback-hosted p99 ~320-420ms depending on region and seq len. Put range to avoid false precision.

PricingHelper: Billing note suggestion: "Dedicated reserved charges continue; overflow tokens billed at hosted unit rates; egress/cross-region fees billed separately. POC billing cap available on request."

Ava Singh: Procurement asked for a 'worst-case monthly delta' line. Use a short scenario: 48h at 70% overflow. PricingHelper, rough number?

PricingHelper: Baseline Dedicated (2x mid-GPU): $16k/mo. Scenario adds ~ $7k. Note cell: 'Worst-case (48h,70% overflow): +$7k (+44%)' with assumptions footnoted in appendix.

Ellen Park: Legal wants a one-line procurement clause about liability if fallback is used. Draft: "Controlled fallback may be enabled only by signed addendum; Redwood disclaims liability for cross-region processing where Customer has expressly authorized fallback in writing."

Diego Morales: Add short API example for appendix so infra teams can validate behavior. Keep tiny.

Diego Morales: ```bash
# disable overflow fallback for project '10x-poc'
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/10x-poc/fallback \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"action":"disable","drain_seconds":300}'
```

Ava Singh: Also include audit statement: "Fallback enable/disable events, user, timestamp, and justification are retained 540 days and exportable to SIEM (per plan)."

Ellen Park: Great. I'll assemble the capability-matrix row with these cells and attach: redacted SOC page, network sketch, and the billing cap template. Links: https://files.redwood.internal/sales/10x/soc_redacted.pdf , https://files.redwood.internal/sales/10x/network_sketch.png , https://docs.redwood.internal/poc-billing-cap-template

PricingHelper: Also note: customers can request overflow billing caps specific to hosted overflow traffic; include contact billing@redwood.ai.

Ellen Park: Perfect 1'll finalize and send to 10x procurement by EOD. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
